Commentary.Commentary: Now then, the target is a big one but the wicket is good to bat on. Zimbabwe will need to bat sensibly if they want to chase this down. Bangladesh would back themselves to defend it. Join us for the chase in a bit.

The Zimbabwe bowlers weren't that great! They did manage to take wickets at the right time but were offering too many bad balls too. Every bowler went for over 5 per over. However, all of them except for Raza managed to pick a wicket. Still though, they will not be happy with their performance.

End of a brilliant batting performance from the hosts! It was led by Liton Das who scored a brilliant ton. He had partnerships with Tamim, Rahim, Shanto and Mahmudullah. However, all the other 4 only managed to get off to starts but failed to make use of it. Mithun however, made use of the start he got and scored a useful half ton that too in quick time. However, Saifuddin's innings could be the match-winning one. His cameo has taken Bangladesh to a total which should be defended by them.
A single to end! Shorter and on the body, this is hit hard down towards long on for one. 22 from the last over and BANGLADESH END WITH 321!
SIX! Hold the pose! Saifuddin you beauty! That is some shot. It is full and on middle, Saifuddin lofts it with a straight bat and clears the long off fence with relative ease.
Nicely played! A yorker outside off, it is carved out towards deep point for two.

SIX! Back-to-back biggies for Saifuddin! One brings two and that is exactly the case for him. This one goes just over though. It is full and on middle, Saifuddin lofts it well over the long on fielder and into the fence.
SIX! Finally connects with one does Saifuddin. It is a slower ball on middle, MS waits for it and hammers it well over the mid-wicket fence.
Swing and a miss! Saiffudin is looking to hit the ball a little too hard. It is short and outside off, Saifuddin swings but misses.
WIDE! That si very, very wide. Almost close to a no ball as it almost pitched outside the pitch. Wided.
A single to end which means Saifuddin regains the strike! A low full toss on off, it is hit down to long off for one.
A huge roar from the crowd as out comes their skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza to bat.

OUT! Hasan holes out! Mpofu has the last laugh. This is bowled slightly short and on middle, Hasan looks to pull but gets it high on the bat. He holes out to the fielder in the deep mid-wicket region.
SIX! Hasan connects with one and it sails over the fence. Misses his length by a little and Mpofu pays the price. It is full and on middle, Hasan tonks it well over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Saifuddin misses out there! A full toss on off, MS swings but gets an inside edge onto the pads. It rolls on the off side for one.
On middle, this is worked behind square on the leg side for one.
Very full and on middle, difficult to hit those. All Saifuddin could do is jam it out towards mid off for one.
A dot to end a very good over by Mpofu! Full and on off, it is driven towards covers.

OUT! plumb in front! Almost a similar manner to how Mahmudullah got out! Mithun walks right across and looks to flick. Mpofu bowls it very full and on middle. He fails to put bat on ball and it hits him on the pads. An appeal and up goes the finger. A good little innings from Mithun comes to an end, he falls just after getting to his half ton.

FOUR! Lovely placement! Not an easy shot that. It is a slower one, it is shorter in length and there is extra bounce. Mithun gets on top of the bounce and guides it nicely through point for a boundary. Brings up his fifty in good style. Needs to help his team finish well here.
Just one! Saifuddin comes down the track. Mpofu bowls it wide outside off. Mithun looks to put bat on ball but it goes off the outside edge and down towards third man for one.
Hammered but for no runs! Outside off, Saifuddin slaps it hard but straight to covers.
A good slower one, fuller and around off, it is driven towards cover for one.
A single to end! Outside off, it is guided towards point for one.
Another run! Shorter ad on the body, Saifuddin pulls it through square leg. The fielder in the deep fumbles but it is just a single.
Very full and on middle, it is hit back to the bowler. A dot.
A single now! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Width on offer and Mithun makes the bowler pay. It is outside off, MM guides it through cover-point and the ball races away to the fence.
Full and wide outside off Saifuddin hits it towards cover for one.
A single to end! On middle, it is hit down to long on for one.

OUT! It is right on the pads and three reds! Successful review by the visitors! It is a yorker on middle, Mahmudullah looks to flick but seems to have missed it. An appeal goes up but the umpire shakes his head. Zimbabwe review straight away! Replays roll in and it shows it is hitting the pad and the on-field call has to be overturned. A good wicket as this could easily mak a difference of at least 10 runs to the final total.
An appeal for an LBW has been turned down but Zimbabwe review. Not sure if it has hit the bat or the pad.
On off, it is kept out towards covers for one.

EDGED, DROPPED AND FOUR! A tough chance though. Bangladesh won't care how they come as long as they do. Length and around off, Mithun looks to push it through the off side but gets an outside edge. It flies to the right of the keeper who dives but only gets a hand to it. It races down to the third man fence.
Good running! A slower one on middle, Mithun works it with soft hands towards mid-wicket and takes two.
A slower one on off, it is worked towards the leg side for one.
A single again! Outside off, it is carved through point for one. End of another huge over.
Fires it on off, it is pushed to covers.
SIX! That is colossal! Mahmudullah comes down the track and goes with the turn. He hammers it well over the mid-wicket fence for a huge one.
Slower through the air and outside off, Mithun flat bats it down to long off for one.
On off now, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Raining boundaries here now! This is a poor ball. Full and fast and on the pads, Mahmudullah helps it on its way to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! 12 from the over! Excellent one for Bangladesh. Mithun brings out the reverse sweep and hits it nice and fine for a boundary.
Shorter and quicker outside off, Mithun looks to cut but misses. Two dots.
Fires this wide outside off, MM reaches out for it but mistimes it towards covers.
On the pads, Mahmudullah works it through square leg for one.
Now smartly drops it towards point and takes an easy run.

SIX! Finally a big shot comes and it goes all the way. This is right in the slot. Full and on middle, Mithun lofts it with ease over the long on fence. Good start to the over, can they make it count now?
One more single to end! Mithun comes down the track but gets a little too close to the pitch of the delivery. He hits it down to long on for one.
Another single as this is worked towards the man at short fine leg.

A better throw could have had Mahmudullah in trouble! This is fired on off, it is a full toss. Mithun hits it to covers and takes off. The fielder picks it up and fires a wide throw to the keeper and hence, Mahmdullah makes it in.
Fires it on the pads, Mahmudullah works it through square leg and gets to the other end.
Mithun makes room and Raza slows it up. MM pushes it through covers for one.
Very full and outside off, Mahmudullah jams it through point and takes one.
Does so! Just the 5 runs from it. Very full and on middle, it is hit down to long on for one.
Very full and on middle, this is hit down to long on for one. Another good over this, needs to end it well.
Another single as once again the delivery is pushed towards sweeper covers.
Just a single again! Shorter in length and outside off, Mithun slaps it through covers but only for one.
This time he drops it towards cover and takes an easy run.
On off, Mahmudullah plays it towards cover and wants a run but is sent back.
One more dot! Just three runs from the over. Another yorker on middle. It is jammed out.
Slower through the air this time and around off, Mithun keeps it out.
A yorker on middle, this is jammed out towards cover.
Around off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
Shorter in length and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one.

A couple! Slightly shorter again, this time Mithun beats point but the sweeper cover fielder runs to his left and cuts it off. Two taken.

Leading edge and it goes over covers! Two runs in the end. The leg spinner outside off, Mithun feels it a googly and he looks to work it on the leg side. It goes off the leading edge but over covers for two.
A single to end another decent over for Bangladesh! On the pads, it is worked through square leg for one.
On off, it is pushed towards the man at covers.
One more single! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! That is an amazing shot! It is on the pads, Mahmudullah goes back and works it gently. He finds the gap in the square leg region. The outfield is very quick and it races to the fence.
On the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Now smartly works it through mid-wicket and takes one.
FOUR! Lovely placement! A full toss and Mithun puts it away. He nonchalantly works it wide of long on and it races away to the fence.
One more googly, it is on off. MM keeps it out.
Very full outside off, Mithun looks to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

SIX! That is massive! Das is dealing in boundaries now! He comes down the track and this is fired outside off. Das drags it well over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie. Das though is struggling at the moment. Maybe with cramps.
Flatter and on off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
A single to end an expensive over! 14 from it. Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Now takes a single! Clever batting! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Third boundary in the four balls of this over! This time through the off side. It is shorter in length and outside off, Das cuts it wide of point and bags another boundary.
The physio does come out to have a look though. He is fine now and all set to continue.
Hit on the helmet! Shorter and around middle, Das looks to pull but misses to get hit on the helmet. The umpire straightaway signals the physio to come out but Das says he is okay.

FOUR! Another excellent shot! This is even better than the last one. He comes down the track this time, makes it into a fuller length and just clips it over mid-wicket for another boundary. 8 from 2 balls.
FOUR! A tad short and it put away! Short and on middle, Das picks it up and hits it over mid-wicket for a boundary. Good start to the over.
One more dot! On middle, Mahmudullah works it to mid-wicket.
On the pads, it is worked through square leg for an easy run.
On off, Mahmudullah taps it towards cover and takes one. He is off the mark.
On the pads, this is worked towards square leg.
On off, Mahmudullah drops it towards cover and wants a run but is sent back.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Once again a timely wicket as the partnership had just started to flourish. This is shorter and around off, Rahim looks to guide it down to third man but there is not a lot of room. It hits the glove and goes into the hands of the keeper.
A couple now! Shorter and around leg, it is worked with soft hands towards backward square leg for two.
In the air... safe! Das must have decided to step on the gas now. He comes down the track and looks to go inside out over covers. Mistimes it towards cover-point for one.
Back of a length and on off, Rahim drops it on the off side and takes one.
A single as this is guided down to third man for one.

FOUR! 100 for Liton Das! A special moment for Das. He has played brilliantly and it is a well-deserved ton. He gets a gift to get to the milestone. Full and on the pads, it is worked through mid-wicket for a boundary. Still a lot of time to go. Can he make it a big one?
Donald Tiripano is back on!

Das takes one as he strokes it through mid on now.

A huge shout but not given! This is flatter and just outside off. Rahim looks to pull but misses to get hit on the pads.
A full toss on the pads, Rahim works it through mid-wicket for one.

OUT! LBW! Zimbabwe have got the breakthrough. Shanto, who was really looking to hit every ball, perishes. A much-needed breakthrough for the visitors as this stand was taking the game away form them. This is very full and on middle, Shanto picks the wrong ball to sweep. He misses and is hit on the front pad. An appeal and up goes the finger. Can Zimbabwe now slowly crawl back into the game? Now then, replays just show that he impact was outside off. Unlucky was Shanto. Bangladesh had no reviews left.

A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.

flighted ball on off, it is driven to mid off.

OUT! Three reds and Tamim is a goner! On middle, Tamim looks to work it on the leg side but the ball straightens, goes past the bat and hits the front pad. An appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Tamim has a puzzled look on his face but he then reviews, Replays show that the on-field call is the right one. Tamim takes the only review with him as he walks back. FIRST ODI WICKET FOR MADHEVERE!

A direct hit and the umpire takes it upstairs! Tamim is the man in question! On a length and around the pads. Tamim misses the flick. It rolls towards point. They go for a run. The fielder hits bull's eye at the non-striker's end. NOT OUT! Replays show that Tamim's dive saves him.

The players make their way out to the middle! Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are the openers. Chris Mpofu will start the proceedings for Zimbabwe. Here we go...
